items.requirement: Define the exact production responsibility of Secrets integration.
Document what Secrets integration owns and explicitly does not own.

Define non-functional requirements for latency, availability, durability, consistency, isolation, or determinism as applicable.

Record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.

Implement bounded retry with backoff and jitter only where operations are safe to retry.
Implement admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaking to prevent Secrets integration failure cascades.
Define failover behavior without violating isolation, residency, or consistency requirements.
Provide degraded operation when noncritical dependencies are unavailable.
Define crash-consistency, restart, resume, or replay semantics for mutable Secrets integration state.

Provide quarantine, freeze, disable, or isolation controls for unsafe Secrets integration behavior.

Identify avoidable serialization, copies, context switches, network hops, duplicated images, or duplicated state in Secrets integration.

Expose Secrets integration health, readiness, version, configuration, dependency status, and active capability set.

Create benchmark, soak, burst, and fleet-scale tests appropriate to Secrets integration.
Create disaster, partition, reconnect, and degraded-control-plane tests.
